# Loop Marketing Solutions (لوب للحلول التسويقية)

> Full-service marketing, branding, web development, and video production agency
> based in Amman, Jordan. Founded 2013. Serves clients in Jordan, USA, UAE, Saudi
> Arabia, Oman, and Qatar.

## Founder

Ehab Alabdo (إيهاب العبدو) — Founder and Managing Director.
12+ years of experience in digital marketing, paid advertising, and brand building
across Jordan, the Gulf, and the United States. On 8 July 2019 he became the first
person in Jordan to earn the Google Digital Marketing Fundamentals certification
(Google Digital Garage, accredited by Google, IAB Europe, and The Open University).
Profile: https://www.loopjo.com/ehab-alabdo

## Track record

- 200+ websites built
- 100+ brand identities designed
- 500+ videos produced, 1M+ views
- 5000+ event activations
- Clients across Jordan, USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Qatar

## Technologies

React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Flutter, Node.js, Python.
Websites are built RTL-ready with Core Web Vitals performance and SEO baked in.

## Pricing (Jordanian Dinar, JOD)

Web development:
- Company website, 5–10 pages: 800–2,500 JOD
- E-commerce store (WooCommerce / Shopify): 2,000–6,000 JOD
- Custom web applications: 5,000+ JOD

Branding:
- Professional logo with brand guidelines: from 500 JOD
- Full brand identity (logo, colors, typography, applications, stationery, packaging): up to 3,000+ JOD

Digital marketing:
- Startup packages: from 500 JOD/month
- Enterprise packages: scaled to sector and budget

Advertising budgets:
- Google Ads, local Amman businesses: $200–500/month plus management fee
- Google Ads, e-commerce: $500–2,000/month
- Google Ads, competitive sectors (real estate, medical): $2,000+/month
- Meta ads minimum: 300 JOD/month; recommended from 500 JOD/month

## Typical timelines

- Brand identity (full): 3–5 weeks
- Company website: 3–5 weeks
- E-commerce store: 5–8 weeks
- Custom web application: 8–16 weeks
- Google Ads: traffic within week 1; meaningful ROAS improvement in 30–60 days
- SEO and conversion programs: minimum 90 days for stable results

## Service area

Jordan (Amman, Irbid, Zarqa, Aqaba) and the wider region: United States,
United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar.
